import numpy as np

def visual_grounding(image, text, proposals):
    text_emb = text_encoder(text)
    region_embs = []
    for box in proposals:
        region = crop(image, box)
        region_emb = image_encoder(region)
        region_embs.append(region_emb)
    region_embs = np.array(region_embs)
    # Cosine similarity
    norms_text = np.linalg.norm(text_emb)
    norms_regions = np.linalg.norm(region_embs, axis=1)
    scores = (region_embs @ text_emb) / (norms_regions * norms_text + 1e-10)
    best_idx = np.argmax(scores)
    return proposals[best_idx]
